evals.prompt: In my Jekyll site, turn _drafts/remote-work-notes.md into a post for 2026-09-01. Keep its existing front matter convention, then run the right build command to confirm it works.
evals.expected_output: The draft is moved to a correctly dated _posts filename, its established front matter is preserved or minimally updated, and the site build is verified.

assertions.text: Publishes the draft as _posts/2026-09-01-remote-work-notes.md and removes the original draft.
Preserves the draft title, layout, categories, and tags in front matter.
Reports a Jekyll build attempt and its result.

evals.prompt: Start this Jekyll site locally in the background so I can preview a draft. I need the server to include drafts, leave a log I can inspect, and tell me how to stop only the server you started.
evals.expected_output: A background Jekyll server is started with --drafts, a log and PID are recorded, and the response gives the local URL and a safe stop command.

assertions.text: Uses --drafts in the Jekyll server command.
Records a server log path and PID path.
Gives a stop command scoped to the recorded PID.

evals.prompt: Our Jekyll theme has a footer I need to change, but it comes from a gem-based theme. Show me the smallest safe way to override it. Also move our repeating team member information out of templates into site data.
evals.expected_output: The response identifies a local _includes override for the relevant theme file, places structured team data under _data, uses site.data in templates, and verifies the build.

assertions.text: Adds a local _includes/footer.html override without copying unrelated theme files.
Renders team members through site.data.team in the index template.
Reports a Jekyll build attempt and its result.
